chunks: Muḥammad ibn Manṣūr asked Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them.
About a man who vowed fasting, then fasting became burdensome for him. He said: “He gives charity for each day with one mudd of wheat.”

key_terms.بِمُدٍّ: by one mudd, a known measure
key_terms.صِيَامًا: fasting as the subject of the vow
key_terms.كُلِّ يَوْمٍ: each day covered by the vow

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he vowed to fast but finds the fasting too difficult?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a person who made a vow to fast but is unable to bear it due to hardship. The expiation stated here is to give charity for each day in the measure of one mudd of wheat.
